title: CreateWalletWithSignatureResponse
description: Returned by `/create_wallet_with_signature`. The client must follow up with an on-chain `registerWalletDerivation(adminHash, wallet_address, derivation_path, name, description)` call signed by the same wallet — until that lands, the PKP exists in MPC but is not registered to any account.

derivation_path.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase hex (uint256). Pass through verbatim to `registerWalletDerivation`'s `derivationPath` arg.
